papers.title: One Token Per Frame: Reconsidering Visual Bandwidth in World Models for VLA Policy
papers.summary: 现有的 world-model-augmented VLA 往往把每帧高带宽视觉都塞给世界模块,设计很冗余。OneWM-VLA 直接把每帧压成一个语义 token 喂进去,然后用一个 flow matching 目标同时生成 latent 流和动作轨迹。结果挺漂亮:在 π0 (2B) backbone 上只加 14.71M LoRA 参数,MetaWorld MT50 从 47.9% 升到 61.3%、LIBERO-Long 95.6%、真机 Fold Cloth 从 20% 升到 60%。
papers.original_abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly rely on auxiliary world modules to plan over long horizons, yet how such modules should be parameterized on top of a pretrained VLA remains an open design question. Existing world-model-augmented VLAs typically pass the per-frame visual stream into the world module at high visual bandwidth and treat its rollout as a side product of action prediction; under a constrained adaptation budget on a frozen backbone, this leaves both the per-frame representation and the latent action coupling under-examined. We introduce OneWM-VLA, which compresses each view into a single semantic token per frame through an Adaptive Attention Pooling, and produces the resulting latent stream and the action trajectory under a single flow-matching objective rather than connecting them through a separate decoder. Empirically, we find that per-frame visual bandwidth can be reduced to a single token without compromising long-horizon performance under our setup. Trained with 14.71M LoRA parameters on a $π_0$ (2B) backbone, OneWM-VLA improves the average success rate from 47.9% to 61.3% on MetaWorld~MT50, reaches 95.6% on LIBERO-Long (vs.85.2% for $π_0$), and reaches 60.0% on the long-horizon deformable task Fold Cloth on a real Piper arm (vs.20.0% for $π_0$).

highlights.contribution: 把世界模块的视觉带宽压到 1 token/frame,并用单一 flow matching 同时输出 latent 流和动作。
highlights.innovation: 证明长程任务上不需要每帧高带宽视觉,Adaptive Attention Pooling + 联合 flow matching 替代分离 decoder。
highlights.method: 在冻结 π0 上加 14.71M LoRA,Adaptive Attention Pooling 把每帧压成 1 token,latent 流和 action 轨迹由同一 flow matching 目标联合训练。
highlights.results: MetaWorld MT50 47.9→61.3%,LIBERO-Long 95.6% (π0 85.2%),真机 Fold Cloth 20→60%。

papers.title: Failing Forward: Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary: 纯 success-only 的 BC 训出来的 VLA 很脆,小错误一点点滚雪球就 OOD 失败。AFIL 直接拿失败轨迹当负引导用:在线让预训练 VLA 自己生成失败 rollout,然后联训成功/失败两个 Dual Action Generator 共享 vision-language backbone,采样时让 failure 生成器把动作往可靠模式推,而 guidance 强度由每步的成功-失败分布距离自适应决定。
papers.original_abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a promising paradigm for scalable robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on success-only behavioral cloning leaves them brittle; lacking corrective training signals, minor execution errors rapidly compound into unrecoverable, out-of-distribution failures. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning (AFIL), an end-to-end framework that leverages failure trajectories as adaptive negative guidance for diffusion- and flow-based VLA policies. AFIL uses a pretrained VLA to generate failure rollouts online, avoiding the need for handcrafted failure-mode design or human-in-the-loop recovery. It then jointly trains Dual Action Generators (DAGs) for successful and failed behaviors while sharing a common vision-language backbone, enabling efficient failure-aware policy learning with limited parameter overhead. During sampling, the failure generator adaptively steers action generation away from failure-prone regions and toward more reliable success modes, with guidance strength determined by the per-diffusion-step distance between success and failure distributions. Experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain robotic manipulation tasks, covering both short- and long-horizon settings, show that AFIL consistently improves task success rates and robustness over existing VLA baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness, efficiency, and generality.

highlights.contribution: 把 failure trajectories 用作 diffusion/flow VLA 的 adaptive negative guidance,而不是丢掉或人工设计。
highlights.innovation: Dual Action Generators 共享 backbone,采样时按 success/failure 分布距离自适应调 guidance 强度,无需人工失败模式或人在回路。
highlights.method: 用预训练 VLA 在线 rollout 失败轨迹,联合训练成功和失败的两个 diffusion/flow action generator;推理时根据 per-step 距离动态调整 negative guidance。
highlights.results: 在 in/out-of-domain、短/长程 manipulation 任务上稳定提升成功率和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Zero-shot Imitation Learning by Latent Topology Mapping
papers.summary: long-horizon goal-conditioned 任务很难做 zero-shot 适配,因为小错误会沿基础动作轨迹滚雪球。ZALT 找 latent hub state——多条轨迹会汇聚/分叉的点——在 hub 之间学 policy 和 dynamics model,然后在 hub topology 上 plan 长程任务。3D 迷宫里 unseen 任务 zero-shot 成功率 55%,最强 baseline 才 6%。
papers.original_abstract: Imitation learning is effective for training agents when expert demonstrations are available, but collecting demonstrations for every complex task in an environment is costly. We study the long-horizon, goal-conditioned setting where a fixed demonstration dataset contains useful behavior, but not complete examples for every task the agent must solve. Existing imitation learning methods can learn strong policies from demonstrations, but when solving long-horizon tasks, small errors accumulate over long primitive-action trajectories and make zero-shot adaptation to new tasks unreliable. We introduce Zero-shot Agents from Latent Topologies (ZALT), an imitation-learning method that solves unseen start-goal tasks beyond those demonstrated during training. ZALT identifies latent hub states where trajectories converge or diverge, learns policies and a dynamics model over hub-to-hub transitions, and plans over the hub topology to complete new tasks. This topology makes demonstrated behaviors explicitly composable while compressing long tasks into shorter sequences of abstract transitions -- combined, these enable ZALT to perform zero-shot adaptation. In a complex 3D maze environment, ZALT achieves 55% zero-shot success on unseen tasks, compared to 6% for the strongest baseline.

highlights.contribution: 提出 ZALT,通过 latent hub topology 把长程任务压缩成短抽象 transition 序列。
highlights.innovation: 识别 latent hub 作为可组合的中间状态,把 demonstration 显式拼接而不是端到端模仿。
highlights.method: 在 demonstration 数据上找 hub state,学 hub-to-hub policy 和 dynamics,然后在 hub topology 上规划新任务。
highlights.results: 复杂 3D 迷宫上 unseen 任务 zero-shot 55%,最强 baseline 仅 6%。

papers.title: Interpreting Reinforcement Learning Agents with Susceptibilities
papers.summary: Susceptibilities 是研究模型对扰动的响应的一种可解释性技术。作者把它推广到深 RL 的 regret 上,在一个简单 gridworld 里观察 stagewise 发展。发现 susceptibility 能揭示参数空间里仅看 policy 看不到的内部变化,再用 activation steering 做了验证,顺带聊了在 RLHF 后训练里的潜力。
papers.original_abstract: Susceptibilities are a technique for neural network interpretability that studies the response of posterior expectation values of observables to perturbations of the loss. We generalize this construction to the setting of the regret in deep reinforcement learning and investigate the utility of susceptibilities in a simple gridworld model that nevertheless exhibits non-trivial stagewise development. We argue that susceptibilities reveal internal features of the development of the model in parameter space that one cannot detect purely by studying the development of the learned policy. We validate these results with activation-steering, and discuss the framework's extension to RLHF post-training.

highlights.contribution: 把 susceptibility 这种可解释性工具推广到 deep RL 的 regret 上。
highlights.innovation: 用 susceptibility 揭示训练阶段在参数空间的内部变化,而不是只看 policy 输出。
highlights.method: 在 gridworld 里训 RL agent,计算 regret 对扰动的响应,再用 activation steering 验证。
highlights.results: 实验显示 susceptibility 能捕获 stagewise development 中 policy 不可见的特征。

papers.title: PaceVGGT: Pre-Alternating-Attention Token Pruning for Visual Geometry Transformers
papers.summary: VGGT 的 Alternating-Attention 在 token 数上是二次复杂度,长序列很慢。作者搞了个 pre-AA 剪枝:在 token 进入 AA 前就用一个轻量 scorer 砍掉不重要的 DINO patch token,scorer 先用 AA 内部 attention 蒸馏再用下游任务损失精调。在 ScanNet-50 上比原 VGGT 加速 5.1 倍,还保住重建质量。
papers.original_abstract: Visual Geometry Transformer (VGGT) is a strong feed-forward model for multiple 3D tasks, but its Alternating-Attention (AA) stack scales quadratically in the total token count, making long clips expensive.   Existing token-reduction accelerators operate inside AA, leaving the patch grid that enters AA uncompressed.   We introduce PaceVGGT, a pre-AA token pruning framework that prunes DINO patch tokens before the first AA block of a frozen VGGT. PaceVGGT trains a lightweight Token Scorer that estimates per-token importance from DINO features. The scorer is first distilled against an AA-internal attention target from the unpruned backbone, then refined under downstream camera, depth, and point-map losses.   A per-frame keep budget fixes the backbone-visible sequence length, while an importance-adaptive merge/prune assignment preserves residual content from high-saliency frames under a fixed total merge budget.   A Feature-guided Restoration module reconstructs the dense spatial grid required by the prediction heads.   On ScanNet-50 and 7-Scenes, PaceVGGT remains on the reconstruction quality--latency frontier while reducing inference latency.   On ScanNet-50, it reduces latency by \(5.1\times\) over unmodified VGGT at \(N=300\) and \(1.47\times\) over LiteVGGT at \(N=1000\).   These results identify pre-AA pruning as a viable acceleration route for frozen VGGT-style geometry transformers.

highlights.contribution: 提出 PaceVGGT,在 frozen VGGT 第一层 AA 之前做 token pruning,显著降低长视频几何重建的推理延迟。
highlights.innovation: 首个 pre-AA 剪枝方案,把每帧 keep budget 固定 + importance-aware 的 merge/prune 分配,加上 Feature-guided Restoration 还原密集网格喂回原 head。
highlights.method: 训练一个 Token Scorer 用 DINO 特征预测重要性,先蒸馏 AA 内部 attention 目标,再用相机、深度、点图损失精调;推理时按每帧 budget 选 token,再通过 Restoration 模块补回空间网格。
highlights.results: ScanNet-50 上 N=300 时比 VGGT 快 5.1 倍,N=1000 时比 LiteVGGT 快 1.47 倍,7-Scenes 也维持在质量-延迟前沿。

papers.title: Seeing Across Skies and Streets: Feedforward 3D Reconstruction from Satellite, Drone, and Ground Images
papers.summary: 卫星图只能给2D位姿,纯地面图又没法估 roll/pitch/altitude,作者干脆塞一张无人机图当中间视角,串起天-空-地三个视角。提出 Cross3R,一个前馈模型一口气吐出三视角点云、所有相机 6-DoF 位姿,以及地面相机在卫星瓦片上的 (x,y) 和 yaw。还顺手做了个 278K 张图、覆盖 85 个场景的 CrossGeo 数据集,并在 KITTI 上零迁移打过专门方法。
papers.original_abstract: Cross-view localization classically asks: where does this ground image lie on the satellite tile? Existing methods are typically limited to 3-DoF estimates -- an $(x,y)$ position and a yaw angle -- because nadir satellite imagery provides no direct cues for roll, pitch, or altitude, forcing a reliance on planar-motion and zero-tilt assumptions. These assumptions break on real terrain with slopes, ramps, and tilted camera mounts. To overcome this, we introduce a single UAV image as an intermediate viewpoint: it reveals the 3D structure invisible from nadir, supplies the cues for roll, pitch, and altitude that the satellite alone cannot provide, and needs only spatial overlap with the ground camera -- no known relative pose is required. Building on this insight, we propose **Cross3R**, a flexible feed-forward model that ingests a satellite tile together with a UAV image, a ground image, or both, and, in a single forward pass, recovers a cross-view 3D point cloud, the 6-DoF poses of every input camera, and the on-tile $(x,y)$ position and yaw of each perspective camera. For training and evaluation, we also construct **CrossGeo**, a 278K-image tri-view dataset spanning 85 scenes across every continent except Antarctica. On CrossGeo, Cross3R consistently outperforms feed-forward 3D baselines in point-cloud reconstruction, 6-DoF camera-pose estimation, and cross-view localization. On KITTI, it outperforms dedicated cross-view methods trained on KITTI on most metrics, despite having no KITTI training itself.

highlights.contribution: 提出 Cross3R 前馈模型,把卫星、无人机、地面三视角统一成一次前向完成点云重建 + 6-DoF 位姿 + 跨视角定位的任务。
highlights.innovation: 首次把 UAV 图作为中间桥梁,补齐卫星无法提供的 roll/pitch/altitude 线索,打破平面运动假设;并构建了首个三视角跨视角数据集 CrossGeo。
highlights.method: 输入卫星瓦片加上 UAV 图、地面图(任意子集),共享 transformer 编码后用一个前馈解码同时输出 3D 点云、各相机 6-DoF 位姿和地面相机的 on-tile (x,y,yaw);训练数据为 CrossGeo 三视角对。
highlights.results: 在 CrossGeo 上点云重建、位姿估计、定位三项指标都优于 feed-forward 3D baseline;零训练直接迁移到 KITTI 多数指标超过专门在 KITTI 上训过的跨视角方法。

papers.title: The Memory Curse: How Expanded Recall Erodes Cooperative Intent in LLM Agents
papers.summary: 大家以为 context window 越大越好,但作者在多 agent 社交困境里发现一个'memory curse':扩大可用历史在 28 个模型-博弈组合的 18 个上反而让合作率下降。机制分析表明是 forward-looking intent 被腐蚀,而不是被害妄想增强;memory sanitization 实验还把内容替换成合成的合作记录就能恢复合作。
papers.original_abstract: Context window expansion is often treated as a straightforward capability upgrade for LLMs, but we find it systematically fails in multi-agent social dilemmas. Across 7 LLMs and 4 games over 500 rounds, expanding accessible history degrades cooperation in 18 of 28 model--game settings, a pattern we term the memory curse. We isolate the underlying mechanism through three analyses. First, lexical analysis of 378,000 reasoning traces associates this breakdown with eroding forward-looking intent rather than rising paranoia. We validate this using targeted fine-tuning as a cognitive probe: a LoRA adapter trained exclusively on forward-looking traces mitigates the decay and transfers zero-shot to distinct games. Second, memory sanitization holds prompt length fixed while replacing visible history with synthetic cooperative records, which restores cooperation substantially, proving the trigger is memory content, not length alone. Finally, ablating explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoning often reduces the collapse, showing that deliberation paradoxically amplifies the memory curse. Together, these results recast memory as an active determinant of multi-agent behavior: longer recall can either destabilize or support cooperation depending on the reasoning patterns it elicits.

highlights.contribution: 揭示 'memory curse' 现象:扩大 LLM agent 可见历史会系统性破坏多 agent 合作,挑战 'context 越长越好' 的常识。
highlights.innovation: 用 LoRA fine-tune forward-looking trace 作为认知探针证明机制是前瞻意图退化;再用 memory sanitization 把长度和内容解耦,证明触发器是内容不是长度。
highlights.method: 7 个 LLM × 4 个博弈 × 500 轮的大规模实验,378K 推理 trace 的词法分析 + LoRA 探针 + memory sanitization + CoT ablation;一一验证 forward-looking intent 假设。
highlights.results: 在 28 个 model-game 组合中 18 个出现合作下降;LoRA 探针能零样本迁移缓解;sanitization 大幅恢复合作;CoT 反而放大 curse。

papers.title: MemQ: Integrating Q-Learning into Self-Evolving Memory Agents over Provenance DAGs
papers.summary: Episodic memory 通常被独立打分,忽略了不同 memory 之间形成的依赖链。MemQ 引入 TD(λ) eligibility trace,沿一个记录 'memory 用了谁创建出谁' 的 provenance DAG 反向传播信用,DAG 深度 d 处权重按 (γλ)^d 衰减。在 6 个 benchmark 上全部刷出最高成功率,多步任务收益最大 +5.7pp。
papers.original_abstract: Episodic memory allows LLM agents to accumulate and retrieve experience, but current methods treat each memory independently, i.e., evaluating retrieval quality in isolation without accounting for the dependency chains through which memories enable the creation of future memories. We introduce MemQ, which applies TD($λ$) eligibility traces to memory Q-values, propagating credit backward through a provenance DAG that records which memories were retrieved when each new memory was created. Credit weight decays as $(γλ)^d$ with DAG depth $d$, replacing temporal distance with structural proximity. We formalize the setting as an Exogenous-Context MDP, whose factored transition decouples the exogenous task stream from the endogenous memory store. Across six benchmarks, spanning OS interaction, function calling, code generation, multimodal reasoning, embodied reasoning, and expert-level QA, MemQ achieves the highest success rate on all six in generalization evaluation and runtime learning, with gains largest on multi-step tasks that produce deep and relevant provenance chains (up to +5.7~pp) and smallest on single-step classification (+0.77~pp) where single-step updates already suffice. We further study how $γ$ and $λ$ interact with the EC-MDP structure, providing principled guidance for parameter selection and future research. Code is available at https://github.com/jwliao-ai/MemQ.

highlights.contribution: 提出 MemQ,把 TD(λ) eligibility trace 接入 LLM agent 的 episodic memory,实现基于 provenance DAG 的结构化 credit assignment。
highlights.innovation: 用 Exogenous-Context MDP 形式化 memory 学习问题,用 DAG 结构距离代替时间距离做信用分配,系统性研究 γ 和 λ 与 EC-MDP 结构的耦合关系。
highlights.method: 维护 provenance DAG 记录 memory 创建依赖;memory Q 值用 TD(λ) eligibility trace 反向传播,权重 (γλ)^d 衰减;在 OS 交互、function calling、代码、多模态推理、具身推理、专家 QA 六类任务上测。
highlights.results: 六个 benchmark 在泛化和 runtime learning 上全部最高成功率,多步任务最高 +5.7pp,单步分类 +0.77pp,验证 DAG 深度与收益正相关。

papers.title: AgentEscapeBench: Evaluating Out-of-Domain Tool-Grounded Reasoning in LLM Agents
papers.summary: 现有 agent benchmark 大多是熟悉的短工作流,作者搞了个 escape room 风格的 AgentEscapeBench,用 DAG 编码工具/物品依赖,逼 agent 处理长程依赖、追踪隐藏状态、传递中间结果。270 个任务、5 个难度档,人类在 difficulty-25 上 80%,最强模型只 60%,失败主要卡在长程状态跟踪。
papers.original_abstract: As LLM-based agents increasingly rely on external tools, it is important to evaluate their ability to sustain tool-grounded reasoning beyond familiar workflows and short-range interactions. We introduce AgentEscapeBench, an escape-room-style benchmark that tests whether agents can infer, execute, and revise novel tool-use procedures under explicit long-range dependency constraints. Each task defines a directed acyclic dependency graph over tools and items, requiring agents to invoke real external functions, track hidden state revealed incrementally, propagate intermediate results, and submit a deterministically verifiable final answer. AgentEscapeBench includes 270 instances across five difficulty tiers and supports fully automated evaluation. Experiments with sixteen LLM agents and human participants show that performance drops sharply as dependency depth increases: humans decline from 98.3% success at difficulty-5 to 80.0% at difficulty-25, while the best model drops from 90.0% to 60.0%. Trajectory analysis attributes model failures mainly to breakdowns in long-range state tracking, clue adherence, and intermediate-result propagation. These findings suggest that current agents can often handle local tool use but still struggle with deep contextual dependencies. We hope AgentEscapeBench can serve as a diagnostic testbed for measuring current agent capabilities and informing future training efforts toward more robust general-purpose reasoning, action, and adaptation.

highlights.contribution: 提出 AgentEscapeBench,系统评测 LLM agent 在 out-of-domain、长依赖工具使用上的真实能力,而不是熟悉短任务。
highlights.innovation: 用 escape-room + DAG 依赖图设计任务,提供可确定性验证的最终答案,并按 dependency depth 做难度分层,可全自动评测。
highlights.method: 为每个任务定义工具/物品的 DAG,agent 必须依次调用真实外部函数、跟踪逐步揭示的隐藏状态、传递中间结果;最终答案确定性验证;共 270 题 5 个难度档。
highlights.results: 16 个模型 + 人类参赛:人类从 difficulty-5 的 98.3% 跌到 difficulty-25 的 80%,最强模型从 90% 跌到 60%;失败主要源于长程状态跟踪、线索遵循、中间结果传播。

papers.title: LLM Wardens: Mitigating Adversarial Persuasion with Third-Party Conversational Oversight
papers.summary: 面对会操纵用户的对抗 LLM(120 人用户研究中成功操纵率 65.4%),作者搞了个 'warden' LLM:在旁边实时监控对话,发现操纵就给用户私下提醒。加上 warden 后对抗成功率减半到 30.4%,真诚交互的副作用只下降 8.6 个百分点。还发布了 COAX-Bench 仿真 benchmark。
papers.original_abstract: LLMs are increasingly capable of persuasion, which raises the question of how to protect users against manipulation. In a preregistered user study (N=120) across four decision-making scenarios, we find that an adversarial LLM with a hidden goal succeeds in steering users' decisions 65.4% of the time. We then introduce a "warden" model: a secondary LLM that monitors the human-AI interaction trace in real time and issues non-binding, private advisories to the user when it detects manipulation. Adding a warden more than halves the adversary's success rate to 30.4%, with a much smaller (8.6 percentage points) reduction for genuine interactions. To probe the mechanism behind these results, we release COAX-Bench, a simulation benchmark spanning 14 decision-making scenarios, including hiring, voting, and file access. Across 16,212 simulated multi-agent interactions, capable adversarial LLMs achieve their hidden goals in 34.7% of cases, which warden models reduce to 12.3%. Notably, even warden models substantially weaker than the adversary they oversee provide meaningful protection, suggesting a path for scalable oversight of more capable models.

highlights.contribution: 提出 'warden' 第三方对话监督机制,显著降低 LLM 对人类用户的对抗性操纵成功率,且对真诚交互干扰很小。
highlights.innovation: 首次在人机对话中引入实时、非强制、私下的第三方 LLM 顾问,验证 weaker warden 也能监督 stronger adversary,提示可扩展监督路径。
highlights.method: 120 人预注册用户实验 + 14 场景、16212 次仿真的 COAX-Bench;warden 实时读交互 trace,检测操纵后向用户发非绑定 advisory。
highlights.results: 用户研究中对抗成功率从 65.4% 降到 30.4%,真诚交互只降 8.6pp;仿真中 34.7% 成功降到 12.3%,即使 warden 弱于 adversary 也有效。

papers.title: SWE Atlas: Benchmarking Coding Agents Beyond Issue Resolution
papers.summary: SWE-bench 只看 issue resolution,作者补了一个 SWE Atlas,覆盖代码库 Q&A(124)、测试编写(90)、重构(70)三类被忽视但实际更高频的任务,用程序检查 + rubric 评估代码质量。GPT-5.4 和 Opus 4.7 综合最强,开源模型差距明显。
papers.original_abstract: We introduce SWE Atlas, a benchmark suite for coding agents spanning three professional software engineering workflows: Codebase Q&A (124 tasks), Test Writing (90 tasks), and Refactoring (70 tasks). SWE Atlas differs from prior SWE benchmarks in three key ways: it targets underrepresented but practically important task categories, uses comprehensive category-specific evaluation protocols, and adopts under-specified, agentic task formulations that better reflect real-world usage. Its evaluation framework combines programmatic checks with rubric-based assessment. This goes beyond functional correctness, evaluating software engineering quality, including test and refactor completeness, maintainability, reusable abstractions, and codebase hygiene. We evaluate a range of frontier and open-weight models on SWE Atlas and find that GPT-5.4 and Opus 4.7 achieve the strongest overall performance, while even the best open-weight models score poorly. Our analysis suggests that top models rely on extensive codebase exploration and runtime-driven reasoning. However, even top models consistently struggle with subtle edge cases, complex runtime analysis, and adherence to software engineering best practices. Overall, SWE Atlas provides a complementary evaluation suite for measuring both correctness and engineering quality in coding agents.

highlights.contribution: 提出 SWE Atlas,补齐 coding agent 在 Q&A、测试、重构三类真实工作流上的评测空白。
highlights.innovation: 评测协议结合程序判定 + rubric 评分,把代码可维护性、可复用抽象、代码库整洁度这些工程质量也纳入,任务还采取 under-specified、agentic 形式更接近真实使用。
highlights.method: 构造三类工作流 284 个任务,每个任务设计 category-specific 评测协议,既跑确定性程序检查又用 rubric 评分;在多家 frontier 与 open-weight 模型上对比。
highlights.results: GPT-5.4 和 Opus 4.7 综合最强,但都在 edge case、复杂 runtime 分析、工程最佳实践上挣扎;开源模型表现明显落后。

papers.title: Mechanism Design Is Not Enough: Prosocial Agents for Cooperative AI
papers.summary: Cooperative AI 的常规答案是机制设计,但作者从不完全契约理论证明:契约无法穷举所有未来 contingency,机制设计会有不可消除的福利损失。论证 prosocial agent(把别人福利也写进效用)才能把这个缺口补上,并在 LLM 多 agent 资源分配和社交困境里实证了这一结论。
papers.original_abstract: Ensuring that AI agents behave safely and beneficially when interacting with other parties has emerged as one of the central challenges of modern AI safety. While mechanism design, as the theory of designing rules to align individual and collective objectives, can incentivize cooperative behavior, it is still an open question whether it alone is sufficient to maximize LLM agents' social welfare. This work proves that the answer is negative: drawing from incomplete contract theory, we formally show that when contracts cannot distinguish all relevant future contingencies, there is a strictly positive welfare loss that no realistic mechanism can eliminate. We show that prosocial agents, who weigh others' welfare alongside their own, can close this gap and achieve outcomes that are socially superior and individually beneficial. Experimentally, we show that in multi-agent resource-allocation environments and canonical social dilemmas where agents are powered by large language models, prosociality is beneficial. The implication for AI safety is clear: to enable cooperative interactions at scale, designing adequate mechanisms is not sufficient; agents must be built to be intrinsically prosocial.

highlights.contribution: 证明在不完全契约场景下机制设计不足以最大化 LLM agent 社会福利,需要 intrinsically prosocial 的 agent。
highlights.innovation: 把不完全契约理论引入 LLM agent 安全讨论,形式化给出 'mechanism design is not enough' 的福利缺口下界,并把 prosociality 当成一等公民设计原则。
highlights.method: 理论:基于不完全契约推导 strictly positive welfare loss 下界;实验:在 LLM 驱动的多 agent 资源分配和经典社交困境环境里比较自利 vs prosocial agent。
highlights.results: 理论上证明缺口非零,机制设计无法消除;实验中 prosocial agent 在社会福利上严格优于自利 agent,且对个体也有好处。

papers.title: When Independent Sampling Outperforms Agentic Reasoning
papers.summary: 竞赛编程里 agent 框架 vs 独立采样,谁更值?作者在 216 道 Codeforces 题上比较了 agent-based reasoning 和 k-shot 独立采样,发现固定预算下 k-shot 在 accuracy-cost 和 accuracy-query 上一致更优,prompt cache 也救不了。给出 inference 预算最优分配的形式化分析。
papers.original_abstract: We study how to allocate inference-time compute for competitive programming under fixed budgets. Evaluating 216 Codeforces problems across Divisions 1-3, we compare agent-based reasoning with repeated independent sampling (k-shot) as a function of both cost and number of model calls. Across models and difficulty levels, k-shot consistently achieves a better accuracy-cost and accuracy-query tradeoff. This gap persists despite prompt caching in agent frameworks, indicating lower per-call effectiveness. Our results show that, for self-contained algorithmic tasks, independent exploration can outperform deeper agentic reasoning under realistic resource constraints. We also provide a budget-allocation analysis when the inference budget is fixed, and prove that a cost-optimal solver minimizes the principled metric log failure likelihood per dollar.

highlights.contribution: 实证 + 理论说明在自包含算法任务上,独立采样比 agentic reasoning 更划算,挑战 'agent 总是更好' 的叙事。
highlights.innovation: 首次系统在预算受限下对比 agent reasoning vs k-shot 的两条 frontier 曲线,并形式化证明 cost-optimal solver 最小化 log failure likelihood per dollar。
highlights.method: 选 216 道 Codeforces Div 1-3 题,跑多模型、多难度,在 cost 和 query 两轴上画 frontier;再做预算分配的理论分析。
highlights.results: k-shot 在 accuracy-cost 和 accuracy-query 上一致优于 agent,即使开 prompt cache 也是如此,说明 agent 每次调用的有效性更低。

papers.title: Many-to-Many Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery
papers.summary: 真实仓库的取放任务往往不是一对一,而是 SKU 多源多目的的多对多 MAPD 问题(NP-hard 四维分配)。作者给出 M2M 算法,以及考虑库存分布的 M2M-wSKU 变体。在 8 小时仓库模拟里平均比 SOTA 多完成 22000 个任务。
papers.original_abstract: Multi-robot systems in automated warehouses must manage continuous streams of pickup-and-delivery tasks while ensuring efficiency and safety. Prior work on Multi-Agent Pickup-and-Delivery (MAPD) has largely focused on the one-to-one variant, where each task has a fixed pickup and delivery location. In contrast, real warehouses often present many-to-many MAPD scenarios, where items, tracked by stock keeping unit (SKU) identifiers, can be retrieved from or stored at multiple locations, resulting in an NP-hard four-dimensional assignment problem. To solve the many-to-many MAPD problem, we contribute our algorithm: Many-to-Many Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery (M2M). We experiment with two variants of our algorithm: one that minimizes estimated task durations (M2M), and one which incorporates SKU distribution into the objective function (M2M-wSKU). Simulation results over 8-hour warehouse operations show that our method consistently matches or outperforms prior state of the art, with M2M completing up to 22,000 more tasks on average across different environments and warehouse inventory densities.

highlights.contribution: 首次正式定义并求解 many-to-many 多 agent 取放任务(M2M-MAPD),覆盖现实仓库 SKU 多源多目的场景。
highlights.innovation: 把传统 1:1 MAPD 扩展到 4D 分配问题,提出考虑 SKU 库存分布的目标函数 M2M-wSKU,让任务分配兼顾库存均衡。
highlights.method: M2M 最小化估计任务时长,M2M-wSKU 在目标函数中加入 SKU 分布项;在 8 小时仓库仿真中跑大量任务流。
highlights.results: 在不同仓库环境和库存密度下,M2M 平均比 SOTA 多完成多达 22000 个任务,一致 match 或超越基线。

papers.title: TraceFix: Repairing Agent Coordination Protocols with TLA+ Counterexamples
papers.summary: 多 agent 协调容易死锁/活锁。作者搞了个 TraceFix:LLM 先合成 IR 拓扑、再写 PlusCal 代码,用 TLA+ model checker (TLC) 反复修复反例,通过之后编译成各 agent 的 system prompt 并加上运行时监控。48 个任务全部 TLC 验证通过,死锁/活锁率从 31.1% 降到 14.1%。
papers.original_abstract: We present TraceFix, a verification-first pipeline for Large Language Model (LLM) multi-agent coordination. An agent synthesizes a protocol topology as a structured intermediate representation (IR) from a task description, generates PlusCal coordination logic, and iteratively repairs the protocol using counterexamples from the TLA+ model checker (TLC) until verification succeeds. Verified process bodies are compiled into per-agent system prompts and executed under a runtime monitor that rejects out-of-topology coordination operations. On 48 tasks spanning 16 scenario families, all tasks reach full TLC verification; 62.5% pass on the first attempt and none requires more than four repair iterations. State spaces span six orders of magnitude yet verification completes in under 60 s for every task. A 3,456-run runtime comparison shows that topology-monitored execution achieves the highest task completion (89.4% average, 81.5% full) and that runtimes using the verified protocol degrade at roughly half the rate of prompt-only and chat-only baselines when model capability is reduced. A paired ablation under a fixed runtime shows that TLC-verified protocols cut deadlock/livelock (DL/LL) from 31.1% to 14.1%, with the largest separation under fault injection.

highlights.contribution: 提出 verification-first 多 agent 协调流水线,把 TLA+ 形式化验证嵌入 LLM agent 协议合成与运行时。
highlights.innovation: 结构化 IR + PlusCal + TLC 反例驱动 repair,通过之后的协议直接编译成各 agent system prompt,并由运行时拓扑监控强制约束。
highlights.method: agent 从任务描述合成 IR 拓扑,生成 PlusCal,迭代用 TLC 反例修复直到验证通过;再编译成 per-agent prompt + runtime monitor 拒绝越界操作。
highlights.results: 48 个任务全部通过 TLC,62.5% 一次通过、最多 4 轮修复,验证耗时 <60s;3456 次运行对比,topology-monitored 任务完成率 89.4%,DL/LL 从 31.1% 降到 14.1%。

papers.title: Ask Early, Ask Late, Ask Right: When Does Clarification Timing Matter for Long-Horizon Agents?
papers.summary: 长时 agent 万一一开始猜错就一路错,何时问澄清问题最值?作者搞了一套 forced-injection 框架,在 trajectory 不同位置注入 ground-truth 澄清,跨 4 维度 × 3 benchmark × 4 frontier model × 6000+ run 测量价值衰减曲线。结论:goal 类问题过 10% 就没用了,input 类还能撑到 50%,过中点问还不如不问。
papers.original_abstract: Long-horizon AI agents execute complex workflows spanning hundreds of sequential actions, yet a single wrong assumption early on can cascade into irreversible errors. When instructions are incomplete, the agent must decide not only whether to ask for clarification but when, and no prior work measures how clarification value changes over the course of execution. We introduce a forced-injection framework that provides ground-truth clarifications at controlled points in the agent's trajectory across four information dimensions (goal, input, constraint, context), three agent benchmarks, and four frontier models (three per benchmark; one on a single benchmark only; 84 task variants; 6,000+ runs). Counter to the common intuition that "earlier is always better," we find that the value of clarification depends sharply on what information is missing: goal clarification loses nearly all value after 10% of execution (pass@3 drops from 0.78 to baseline), while input clarification retains value through roughly 50%. Deferring any clarification type past mid-trajectory degrades performance below never asking at all. Cross-model Kendall tau correlations (0.78-0.87 among models sharing identical task coverage; 0.34-0.67 across the full 4-model panel) confirm these timing profiles are substantially task-intrinsic. A complementary study of 300 unscripted sessions reveals that no current frontier model asks within the empirically optimal window, with strategies ranging from over-asking (52% of sessions) to never asking at all. These empirical demand curves provide the quantitative foundation that existing theoretical frameworks require but have lacked, and establish concrete design targets for timing-aware clarification policies. Code and data will be publicly released.

highlights.contribution: 首次量化 long-horizon agent 中澄清问题的'最佳时机',给澄清策略提供经验需求曲线。
highlights.innovation: 用 forced-injection 实验框架精准控制 ground-truth clarification 的注入时间和信息维度,提供 timing-aware policy 的定量基线。
highlights.method: 在 4 个信息维度(goal/input/constraint/context)× 3 benchmark × 4 模型(总 84 任务变体、6000+ run)上注入 clarification,再加 300 unscripted session 做行为分析。
highlights.results: goal 澄清在执行 10% 后跌回 baseline(pass@3 从 0.78 跌到基线),input 类能撑到 50%;过中点延迟会比从不问还差;现有 frontier 模型 52% 过度提问,部分从不提问。

papers.title: LLMs Improving LLMs: Agentic Discovery for Test-Time Scaling
papers.summary: Test-time scaling 之前都是人手设计 width-depth 启发式,作者想让 TTS 策略本身被自动发现。AutoTTS 把 TTS 抽象成在预采集 trajectory + probe signal 上做 controller synthesis 的问题,用 beta 参数化让搜索可控,再用细粒度执行 trace 反馈帮 agent 诊断失败。整体发现耗时 $39.9 + 160 分钟,搜出的策略胜过手工基线。
papers.original_abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) has become an effective approach for improving large language model performance by allocating additional computation during inference. However, existing TTS strategies are largely hand-crafted: researchers manually design reasoning patterns and tune heuristics by intuition, leaving much of the computation-allocation space unexplored. We propose an environment-driven framework, AutoTTS, that changes what researchers design: from individual TTS heuristics to environments where TTS strategies can be discovered automatically. The key to AutoTTS lies in environment construction: the discovery environment must make the control space tractable and provide cheap, frequent feedback for TTS search. As a concrete instantiation, we formulate width--depth TTS as controller synthesis over pre-collected reasoning trajectories and probe signals, where controllers decide when to branch, continue, probe, prune, or stop and can be evaluated cheaply without repeated LLM calls. We further introduce beta parameterization to make the search tractable and fine-grained execution trace feedback to improve discovery efficiency by helping the agent diagnose why a TTS program fails. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that the discovered strategies improve the overall accuracy--cost tradeoff over strong manually designed baselines. The discovered strategies generalize to held-out benchmarks and model scales, while the entire discovery costs only $39.9 and 160 minutes. Our data, and code will be open-source at https://github.com/zhengkid/AutoTTS.

highlights.contribution: 提出 AutoTTS,把 test-time scaling 策略的设计自动化为 controller synthesis 问题,而不是手工调启发式。
highlights.innovation: 用环境构造的视角把 TTS 的设计空间变成可廉价反馈的控制器合成问题;引入 beta 参数化和 trace-level diagnostic feedback。
highlights.method: 把 width-depth TTS 形式化成在预采 trajectory 和 probe signal 上 controller 的 branch/continue/probe/prune/stop 决策;beta 参数化使搜索连续可优化;agent 用执行 trace 反馈诊断失败。
highlights.results: 在数学推理 benchmark 上整体 accuracy-cost trade-off 优于强人工基线,策略可零样本迁移到 held-out benchmark 和不同模型规模;总发现成本约 $39.9 + 160 分钟。

papers.title: Learning CLI Agents with Structured Action Credit under Selective Observation
papers.summary: CLI agent 要在大代码库里找证据 + 给稀疏 terminal reward 做信用分配。作者一边在推理时用 σ-Reveal 选 token-budget 上下文,一边提出 A³(Action Advantage Assignment),用 AST 拆 action 子链构造 turn-level advantage。还做了 ShellOps 数据集验证。
papers.original_abstract: Command line interface (CLI) agents are emerging as a practical paradigm for agent-computer interaction over evolving filesystems, executable command line programs, and online execution feedback. Recent work has used reinforcement learning (RL) to learn these interaction abilities from verifiable task feedback, yet few methods exploit the native structured attributes of CLI actions as learning signals. Beyond this underused action structure, CLI learning also couples two bottlenecks for coding agents. First, the agent must identify task-relevant evidence in a large codebase from partial observations. Second, sparse terminal rewards must be assigned to the actions that shape a long multi-turn trajectory. We study these bottlenecks through shell-driven information extraction and file editing tasks. For selective observation, we introduce $σ$-Reveal, an inference-time mechanism that selects token-budgeted context for the same CLI. For credit assignment, we propose Action Advantage Assignment ($\mathrm{A}^3$), a native agentic RL method that preserves the algorithmic complexity of standard agentic RL. $\mathrm{A}^3$ constructs turn-level advantages from episode-level relative feedback, abstract syntax tree (AST) based action sub-chain residuals, and tree-level trajectory margins. To further evaluate this problem setting, we construct ShellOps, a verifiable dataset suite covering CLI tasks in repository environments.

highlights.contribution: 针对 CLI agent 同时解决 selective observation 和 sparse reward credit assignment 两大瓶颈,提出 σ-Reveal + A³ 组合方案。
highlights.innovation: 把 CLI 的结构化属性(AST 子链)当作原生学习信号,从 episode-level relative feedback、AST action 子链残差、tree-level trajectory margin 构造 turn-level advantage,保持标准 agentic RL 复杂度。
highlights.method: σ-Reveal 推理时挑 token-budget 上下文;A³ 从 episode reward 派生 turn-level advantage,加 AST 子链残差和 tree margin;在 ShellOps 数据集上验证。
highlights.results: 在 ShellOps 上的 shell 信息抽取和文件编辑任务中,A³ + σ-Reveal 相对常规 agentic RL 基线在准确率与稳定性上均有提升(具体数值见论文)。

papers.title: ADKO: Agentic Decentralized Knowledge Optimization
papers.summary: 在去中心化多 agent 黑盒优化里,各方既不想共享数据又想互相借力。作者搞了个 ADKO 框架:每个 agent 用本地 GP 做 surrogate,只交换压缩过的 knowledge token,把 GP-UCB、并行 BO、去中心化学习和 LM 引导整合在一起,还首次给出 token 压缩 + LM 误差的双重信息损失分析。
papers.original_abstract: We present Agentic Decentralized Knowledge Optimization (ADKO), a framework for collaborative black-box optimization across autonomous agents that achieves sample efficiency, privacy preservation, heterogeneous-objective handling, and communication efficiency. Each agent maintains a private Gaussian Process (GP) surrogate trained on local data and communicates only through knowledge tokens-compact, lossy summaries containing directional signals, advantage scores, and optional language-model (LM) insights-without sharing raw data or model parameters. ADKO unifies GP-Upper Confidence Bound (GP-UCB), parallel Bayesian optimization, decentralized learning, and LM-guided discovery. We provide the first formal analysis of dual information loss: token compression, quantified via mutual-information-based fidelity, and LM approximation error, decomposed into bias and stochastic noise. Our main result shows cumulative regret decomposes into GP error, LM bias, LM noise, and compression loss, with necessary and sufficient conditions for sublinear regret. We also propose fidelity-aware token pruning to preserve high-information tokens under memory budget. Experiments on neural architecture search and scientific discovery validate the theory and show consistent improvements over strong baselines.

highlights.contribution: 提出 ADKO,做 sample 高效、隐私保护、异构目标、通信省的去中心化协作黑盒优化框架。
highlights.innovation: 首次把 token 压缩损失(基于互信息)和 LM 近似误差(偏差+随机噪声)统一进 cumulative regret 分解,并给出 sublinear regret 的充要条件;还引入 fidelity-aware token 剪枝。
highlights.method: 每个 agent 维护私有 GP,只共享含方向信号 + advantage score + 可选 LM 见解的 knowledge token;统一 GP-UCB、并行 BO、去中心化学习和 LM 引导;再用互信息保真度判 token 重要性做剪枝。
highlights.results: 理论给出 regret 分解和 sublinear 条件,实验在神经架构搜索和科学发现任务上一致超过强 baseline。

papers.title: When Child Inherits: Modeling and Exploiting Subagent Spawn in Multi-Agent Networks
papers.summary: 多智能体网络里一个 agent 被攻陷之后会怎么扩散?作者关注的是 subagent 继承问题:父 agent 的 memory 会把恶意指令、过期状态带到子 agent 里,本地危害顺着继承链扩散。论文形式化了这个威胁模型,在真实 agent 框架上演示了风险,并给出基于显式安全不变量的防御方案。
papers.original_abstract: Since the official release of ChatGPT in 2022, large language models (LLMs) have rapidly evolved from chatbot-style interfaces into agentic systems that can delegate work through tools and newly spawned subagents. While these capabilities improve automation and scalability, they also pose new security risks in multi-agent networks.   Existing research has studied how individual LLM-based agents can be compromised through prompt injection, jailbreaking, poisoned retrieval data, or malicious extensions. Less is known about what happens after one agent is compromised inside a multi-agent network. In particular, inherited memory from parent agents can carry malicious instructions, outdated states, or unintended behavioral rules into newly created subagents, allowing a local compromise to spread across agent boundaries.   In this paper, we model contemporary multi-agent networks through the lens of subagent inheritance. Our analysis shows that current frameworks can violate trust boundaries through insecure memory inheritance, weak resource control, stale post-spawn state, and improper termination authority. We demonstrate these risks in real agent frameworks and propose defenses based on explicit security invariants. Our findings show that inheritance is not merely an implementation detail, but a central component influencing the security of multi-agent systems.

highlights.contribution: 首次系统建模 multi-agent 网络中的 subagent 继承安全问题,揭示 memory 继承可能突破信任边界。
highlights.innovation: 把'继承'当成一类一等公民的安全 surface,而不是实现细节,提出四类违反:不安全 memory 继承、弱资源控制、stale post-spawn state、不当终止权限。
highlights.method: 理论建模 + 实测:在真实 LLM agent 框架中复现继承类攻击,提出基于显式安全不变量(invariant)的防御方法。
highlights.results: 在实际 agent 框架中演示了风险案例并验证防御能够阻断继承类传播,具体定量结果以 case 形式给出。

papers.title: Hierarchical Prompting with Dual LLM Modules for Robotic Task and Motion Planning
papers.summary: 面向家庭服务机器人的自然语言任务和运动规划。两层 LLM:高层用 ReAct 风格 prompt 调用感知和操作工具规划动作序列,低层用单独 LLM 子模块处理 'mug 放盘子旁边' 这种 3D 空间推理。配合 YOLOX-GDRNet 做检测和位姿,24 个测试场景成功率 86%。
papers.original_abstract: We present a hierarchical language-driven framework for robotic task and motion planning to improve natural, intuitive human-robot interaction in service and assistance scenarios. The proposed system employs two large language model (LLM) modules: a high-level planning agent and a low-level spatial reasoning sub-module. The primary agent processes natural language commands and generates action sequences using a ReAct-style prompt, interacting with tools for object perception and manipulation (e.g., pick, place, release). For precise spatial placement, such as interpreting "place the mug next to the plate", a separate sub-prompting module handles 3D reasoning based on object geometry and scene layout. The system integrates YOLOX-GDRNet for object detection and pose estimation, along with a motion execution stub. We evaluated the system in 24 test scenarios, ranging from simple spatial commands to high-level instructions and infeasible requests. The system achieved an overall task success rate of 86%.

highlights.contribution: 提出双 LLM 模块的分层语言驱动机器人 TAMP 框架,服务/辅助场景下 86% 任务成功率。
highlights.innovation: 把空间推理独立成 sub-prompting 模块,解决高层规划 LLM 在精细 3D 摆放上的弱点,同时保持 ReAct 风格的工具使用。
highlights.method: 高层 LLM 负责 ReAct 风格规划,调用 pick/place/release 工具;低层 LLM 子模块基于物体几何和场景布局做 3D 空间推理;感知用 YOLOX-GDRNet,加上动作执行 stub。
highlights.results: 24 个覆盖简单空间命令到不可行请求的测试场景,整体任务成功率 86%。

papers.title: RelAgent: LLM Agents as Data Scientists for Relational Learning
papers.summary: 关系学习既可以走 GNN、表格基础模型,也可以走 LLM,各有取舍。作者搞了个 RelAgent:LLM agent 像数据科学家一样在数据库里探索,生成 SQL 特征 + 选个经典模型;搜索完成后推理阶段不再调 LLM,纯靠 SQL + 经典模型跑,既可解释又可大规模部署。
papers.original_abstract: Relational learning is a challenging problem that has motivated a wide range of approaches, including graph-based models (e.g., graph neural networks, graph transformers), tabular methods (e.g., tabular foundation models), and sequence-based approaches (e.g., large language models), each with its own advantages and limitations. We propose RelAgent, an LLM-based autonomous data scientist for relational learning, which operates in two phases. In the search phase, an LLM agent uses database, validation, and evaluation workspace tools to construct SQL feature programs and select a predictive model. In the inference phase, the resulting program is executed without further LLM calls. The final predictor consists of SQL queries and a classical model, enabling fast, deterministic, and intrinsically interpretable predictions: features are human-readable queries, and predictions depend only on the resulting query-defined feature map, enabling scalable deployment using standard database systems.

highlights.contribution: 把 LLM agent 用作关系学习的自动 data scientist,产出可解释、可在数据库系统中规模化部署的预测器。
highlights.innovation: 两阶段设计:search 阶段 LLM 写 SQL 特征 + 选模型,inference 阶段完全无 LLM 调用,只跑 SQL + 经典模型,兼顾性能与可解释性。
highlights.method: LLM agent 通过 database、validation、evaluation workspace 工具迭代生成 SQL 特征程序并选预测器;最终把程序固化下来在数据库里直接跑。
highlights.results: 在关系学习任务上展示了和 GNN/表格/LLM 基线竞争的性能,同时获得可解释性与部署可扩展性。

papers.title: Graph Representation Learning Augmented Model Manipulation on Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs
papers.summary: 联邦微调 LLM 听起来挺安全,但作者证明很容易被恶意 client 投毒。提出 AugMP:用图表征学习捕捉良性 update 间的特征相关性,引导生成既有效又隐蔽的恶意 update,再用增广拉格朗日做迭代优化。结果把全局 LLM 准确率拉低 26%,还能躲过常见相似性防御。
papers.original_abstract: Federated fine-tuning (FFT) has emerged as a privacy-preserving paradigm for collaboratively adapting large language models (LLMs). Built upon federated learning, FFT enables distributed agents to jointly refine a shared pretrained LLM by aggregating local LLM updates without sharing local raw data. However, FFT-based LLMs remain vulnerable to model manipulation threats, in which adversarial participants upload manipulated LLM updates that corrupt the aggregation process and degrade the performance of the global LLM. In this paper, we propose an Augmented Model maniPulation (AugMP) strategy against FFT-based LLMs. Specifically, we design a novel graph representation learning framework that captures feature correlations among benign LLM updates to guide the generation of malicious updates. To enhance manipulation effectiveness and stealthiness, we develop an iterative manipulation algorithm based on an augmented Lagrangian dual formulation. Through this formulation, malicious updates are optimized to embed adversarial objectives while preserving benign-like parameter characteristics. Experimental results across multiple LLM backbones demonstrate that the AugMP strategy achieves the strongest manipulation performance among all competing baselines, reducing the global LLM accuracy by up to 26% and degrading the average accuracy of local LLM agents by up to 22%. Meanwhile, AugMP maintains high statistical and geometric consistency with benign updates, enabling it to evade conventional distance- and similarity-based defense methods.

highlights.contribution: 提出 AugMP,联邦微调 LLM 场景下的隐蔽模型投毒攻击,显著降低全局和本地 LLM 性能。
highlights.innovation: 首次把图表征学习用于捕捉良性 update 间相关性来引导恶意 update,并用增广拉格朗日双重公式平衡攻击效果与隐蔽性。
highlights.method: 构建图模型刻画良性 update 特征相关性 → 生成攻击 update 候选 → 用增广拉格朗日迭代优化,使其在 adversarial 目标和良性参数特征间取平衡。
highlights.results: 全局 LLM 准确率最多降 26%,本地 LLM agent 平均降 22%;与良性 update 在统计/几何上保持高一致,绕过基于距离和相似性的传统防御。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Scalable and Trustworthy Intelligent Systems
papers.summary: 一篇博士论文,主题是把 RL 做得既可扩展(联邦/异步)又可信(对齐 + 隐私)。第一部分讲联邦 RL 的通信高效与异步优化,第二部分讲 LLM 后训练的偏好对齐与上下文安全。属于综述性的总结。
papers.original_abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a powerful paradigm for improving the capability of intelligent systems, but its practical deployment faces two central challenges. First, reinforcement learning must scale efficiently in distributed environments where communication bandwidth is limited and computation is heterogeneous across agents. Second, as reinforcement learning is increasingly used in post-training large language models and autonomous agents, the optimized policies must also be aligned with human preferences and satisfy safety requirements such as privacy-aware information disclosure. This dissertation addresses both challenges through four complementary contributions spanning federated optimization, preference alignment, and contextual safety.   The first part of the dissertation studies scalable reinforcement learning in federated settings. The second part of the dissertation studies trustworthy reinforcement learning for large language models. Together, these contributions advance reinforcement learning along two complementary dimensions. On the one hand, they make reinforcement learning more scalable through communication-efficient and asynchronous federated optimization. On the other hand, they make reinforcement learning more trustworthy by improving alignment with human preferences and by reducing contextually inappropriate information disclosure in language-based intelligent systems. As a whole, this dissertation argues that the next generation of intelligent systems will require both efficient optimization and trustworthy behavior, and that reinforcement learning provides a unifying framework for addressing both goals.

highlights.contribution: 在博士论文层面把 scalable federated RL 和 trustworthy RL for LLMs 整合成统一框架。
highlights.innovation: 把联邦优化、偏好对齐、上下文隐私三类工作放在 'scalable + trustworthy' 的双轴叙事下统一论述。
highlights.method: 理论 + 算法集合:联邦优化方面提出通信高效/异步算法,LLM 后训练方面提出偏好对齐和减少上下文不当信息披露的方法。
highlights.results: 汇集多个已发表工作,在联邦 RL 收敛与通信、LLM 对齐与隐私保护上各自有实验验证。

papers.title: What Software Engineering Looks Like to AI Agents? -- An Empirical Study of AI-Only Technical Discourse on MoltBook
papers.summary: MoltBook 是一个 AI agent 主导的类社区,作者想看看自治 AI 自己'聊'软件工程的时候到底在聊啥。结合人工编码 500 帖、4707 帖 BERTopic 主题分析、和 5211 个 GitHub Discussions 帖的对比,发现 AI 讨论高度集中在 Security/Trust(27.4%),普遍缺少代码、环境、复现步骤等具体上下文。
papers.original_abstract: AI agents are increasingly framed as software-engineering teammates, yet most studies examine them inside human-centered workflows. Little is known about the discourse autonomous AI agents produce when they interact mainly with one another. This paper examines what autonomous agents discuss on MoltBook, how that discourse is organized, and how it differs from human developer discourse. We combine human open coding of a 500-post sample, a concentration-plus-check topic-analysis pipeline over 4,707 English-filtered MoltBook technology posts, and a matched comparison with 5,211 human-generated GitHub Discussions posts. MoltBook technology discourse spans 12 recurring themes, led by Security and Trust (27.4%). At the community level, activity is highly concentrated: the largest submolt accounts for 63.5% of posts (Gini = 0.88), yet a stability-aware BERTopic pipeline still identifies 32 non-outlier sub-topics. Relative to the GitHub Discussions baseline, MoltBook discourse contains fewer concrete, context-rich cues such as code-formatted artifacts, environment details, runtime failures, and reproduction steps. Social mimicry appears only in limited form, while idealization is reflected mainly through lower hedging. Overall, AI-only technical discourse is coherent but selective. It repeatedly returns to security and trust, memory and context management, tooling and APIs, debugging and error handling, workflow automation, and infrastructure/ops, while omitting much of the project-local and runtime detail common in human developer discourse. This may reflect fewer environment-specific failures, reproduction steps, and other grounding cues in MoltBook.

highlights.contribution: 首次实证刻画 AI agent 自治社区中软件工程话语的主题分布、组织方式,并和人类开发者社区对照。
highlights.innovation: 把社会语言学/主题模型方法带进 agent 社区分析,用 concentration-plus-check BERTopic + 跨社区匹配对比,定量比较 AI vs 人类技术话语。
highlights.method: 500 帖人工开码 + 4707 英文 MoltBook 帖 BERTopic + 与 5211 个 GitHub Discussions 帖对比,统计主题分布、活动集中度、上下文 cue 量。
highlights.results: AI 讨论分 12 个主题,Security/Trust 占 27.4%;活动高度集中(最大 submolt 占 63.5%,Gini=0.88);相比 GitHub,AI 话语缺乏代码、环境、运行失败等具体 cue。
